title: corelib full Standard implementation
description: In progress. Structural compiler/runtime refactors and the normative Corelib/runtime completion contract are complete, but functional and release evidence is not green. The fresh source-tip Corelib baseline is 20/61 passing with no per-target hang after deterministic EOF binding; semantic ABI, enum-layout, generic, and codegen failures remain. Rooted Core.Collections storage and host-backed Core.FS are specified but not implemented. Runtime-kit verification currently lacks valid per-artifact static/shared policy and fresh runner-native proof for Linux x86-64, macOS arm64, and Windows x86-64. Completion requires 61/61 Corelib, full stub retirement, corelib-quality/pckg evidence, and native debug/release static/shared JIT+AOT evidence on all three targets.
